9	/-!
10	# The Jacobian challenge — statement file (with field base change)
11	
12	This is the single, self-contained **statement file** of the project: it collects every
13	definition, instance, and theorem needed to *state* the main result, and nothing else. A reviewer
14	reads this one file, compares it against the original challenge (`references/challenge.lean`, by
15	Christian Merten) and its base-change extension, and is convinced the project formalizes the right
16	thing. The genuinely-missing pieces are `sorry`; the base-change scaffolding (`baseChange`, the
17	stability instances, `idIso`, `compIso`, and `Jacobian.congr` derived from `Jacobian.functor`) is
18	genuinely proved here. Proofs of the `sorry`s live in the rest of the `AlgebraicJacobian/` tree and
19	must not weaken or restate any signature below.
20	
21	By a **smooth curve** we mean a geometrically irreducible, smooth scheme of relative dimension one
22	over a field, proper over that field.
23	
24	## Main definitions
25	
26	* `AlgebraicGeometry.genus` — genus of a proper, smooth curve.
27	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian` — the Jacobian of a proper, smooth curve.
28	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.ofCurve` — the Abel–Jacobi map associated to a `k`-rational point.
29	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.functor` — functoriality of the Jacobian, bundled as a single
30	  contravariant functor `(Curve k)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Grp (Over (Spec k))`.
31	
32	## Main theorems
33	
34	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus` — the Jacobian is smooth of relative
35	  dimension `g = genus C`.
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.exists_unique_ofCurve_comp` — the universal property: the Jacobian is
37	  the Albanese variety of `C`.
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Jacobian.baseChangeIso` — the Jacobian commutes with base change of fields,
39	  together with the identity/cocycle coherences (`baseChangeIso_id`, `baseChangeIso_comp`) and the
40	  Abel–Jacobi compatibility `baseChange_ofCurve`.
41	
42	## Notes
43	
44	`noncomputable` is on the data-carrying declarations: their honest realizations rest on
45	noncomputable Mathlib constructions. Names, argument types, and argument order are verbatim from
46	the challenge; the `noncomputable` modifier is not a signature change.
47	-/
48	
49	set_option autoImplicit false
50	
51	universe u
52	
53	open CategoryTheory Limits MonoidalCategory MonObj
54	
55	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
56	
57	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
58	  -- smooth curve
59	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]
60	  -- proper
61	  [IsProper C.hom]
62	  -- geometrically irreducible
63	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
64	
65	/-- The category of smooth, proper, geometrically irreducible curves over `k`, with morphisms the
66	morphisms of `k`-schemes. -/
67	structure Curve (k : Type u) [Field k] where
68	  /-- The underlying `k`-scheme. -/
69	  carrier : Over (Spec (.of k))
70	  [isProper : IsProper carrier.hom]
71	  [smoothOfRelativeDimension : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 carrier.hom]
72	  [geometricallyIrreducible : GeometricallyIrreducible carrier.hom]
73	
74	attribute [instance] Curve.isProper Curve.smoothOfRelativeDimension Curve.geometricallyIrreducible
75	
76	noncomputable instance (k : Type u) [Field k] : Category (Curve k) where
77	  Hom X Y := X.carrier ⟶ Y.carrier
78	  id X := 𝟙 X.carrier
79	  comp f g := f ≫ g
80	  id_comp := Category.id_comp
81	  comp_id := Category.comp_id
82	  assoc := Category.assoc
83	
84	-- data
85	/-- The genus of a smooth proper curve: the `k`-dimension of the first cohomology group
86	`H¹(C, 𝒪_C)` of the structure sheaf, viewed as a sheaf of `k`-modules on the small Zariski
87	site of `C` (`Scheme.moduleKSheaf`), with cohomology the `Ext` from the constant sheaf
88	(`CategoryTheory.Sheaf.HModule`). Finite-dimensionality of `H¹` is proved downstream. -/
89	noncomputable def genus (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
90	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] : ℕ :=
91	  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
92	  Module.finrank k (Sheaf.HModule (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) 1)
93	
94	-- data
95	/-- The Jacobian of a smooth, proper curve over a field `k`. -/
96	noncomputable def Jacobian (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
97	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
98	    Over (Spec (.of k)) :=
99	  sorry
100	
101	namespace Jacobian
102	
103	/-! ## The Jacobian of `C` is an abelian variety. -/
104	
105	-- data
106	/-- The group scheme structure on the Jacobian of the curve `C`. -/
107	noncomputable instance instGrpObj : GrpObj (Jacobian C) :=
108	  sorry
109	
110	/-- The Jacobian of `C` is smooth of relative dimension `g` over `k`, where `g` is the
111	genus of `C`. -/
112	instance smoothOfRelativeDimension_genus : SmoothOfRelativeDimension (genus C) (Jacobian C).hom :=
113	  sorry
114	
115	/-- The Jacobian of `C` is proper over `k`. -/
116	instance : IsProper (Jacobian C).hom :=
117	  sorry
118	
119	/-- The Jacobian of `C` is geometrically irreducible over `k`. -/
120	instance : GeometricallyIrreducible (Jacobian C).hom :=
121	  sorry
122	
123	/-- The Abel-Jacobi map from a smooth, proper curve to its Jacobian associated
124	to a `k`-rational point of `C`. -/
125	noncomputable def ofCurve (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) : C ⟶ Jacobian C :=
126	  sorry
127	
128	/-- The Abel-Jacobi map sends the `k`-rational point `P` to `0`, where `0` (denoted by `η`) is the
129	neutral element of the group scheme `Jacobian C`. -/
130	theorem comp_ofCurve (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
131	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
132	    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :
133	    P ≫ ofCurve P = η[Jacobian C] :=
134	  sorry
135	
136	/--
137	The universal property of the Jacobian variety: For any abelian variety `A`, any morphism
138	`f : C ⟶ A` with `f(P) = 0` factors uniquely through the Jacobian of `C`. In other words,
139	`Jacobian C` is the Albanese variety of `C`.
140	-/
141	theorem exists_unique_ofCurve_comp (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
142	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
143	    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C)
144	    {A : Over (Spec (.of k))} [Smooth A.hom] [IsProper A.hom] [GrpObj A]
145	    [GeometricallyIrreducible A.hom] (f : C ⟶ A) (hf : P ≫ f = η[A]) :
146	    ∃! (g : Jacobian C ⟶ A), f = ofCurve P ≫ g :=
147	  sorry
148	
149	/-- **Functoriality of the Jacobian**, bundled as a single contravariant functor: a curve goes to
150	its Jacobian group scheme over `k`, and a morphism of curves to the pullback of line bundles. The
151	functor laws (`map_id`, `map_comp`) are embedded in this `Functor`. The object action is pinned to
152	the `Jacobian` above, so everything downstream stays phrased in terms of `Jacobian C`. -/
153	noncomputable def functor (k : Type u) [Field k] :
154	    (Curve k)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Grp (Over (Spec (.of k))) where
155	  obj X := .mk (Jacobian X.unop.carrier)
156	  map _ := sorry
157	  map_id := sorry
158	  map_comp := sorry
159	
160	end Jacobian
161	
162	/-! ## Base change of fields
163	
164	Base change of `k`-schemes along `k → L` sends `X` to `X ×_{Spec k} Spec L`. These definitions and
165	the stability instances are genuine (no `sorry`); they set up the statements of the base-change
166	compatibility of the Jacobian. -/
167	
168	/-- Base change of `k`-schemes along a field homomorphism `k → L`, i.e. `X ↦ X ×_{Spec k} Spec L`.
169	-/
170	noncomputable abbrev baseChange (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
171	    Over (Spec (.of k)) ⥤ Over (Spec (.of L)) :=
172	  Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))
173	
174	instance {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
175	    [IsProper C.hom] : IsProper ((baseChange k L).obj C).hom :=
176	  MorphismProperty.baseChange_obj (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))) C inferInstance
177	
178	instance {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
179	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] : GeometricallyIrreducible ((baseChange k L).obj C).hom :=
180	  MorphismProperty.baseChange_obj (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))) C inferInstance
181	
182	instance {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
183	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] :
184	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((baseChange k L).obj C).hom :=
185	  have : MorphismProperty.IsStableUnderBaseChange (@SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1) :=
186	    smoothOfRelativeDimension_isStableUnderBaseChange 1
187	  MorphismProperty.baseChange_obj (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L))) C inferInstance
188	
189	-- The coherences mention curves of the form `(𝟭 _).obj C` and `(F ⋙ G).obj C`.
190	instance {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom] :
191	    IsProper ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C).hom := ‹_›
192	instance {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
193	    GeometricallyIrreducible ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C).hom := ‹_›
194	instance {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] :
195	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k)))).obj C).hom := ‹_›
196	
197	instance {k L M : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Field M] [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M]
198	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom] :
199	    IsProper ((baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C).hom :=
200	  inferInstanceAs (IsProper ((baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).hom)
201	instance {k L M : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Field M] [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M]
202	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
203	    GeometricallyIrreducible ((baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C).hom :=
204	  inferInstanceAs (GeometricallyIrreducible ((baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).hom)
205	instance {k L M : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Field M] [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M]
206	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] :
207	    SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M).obj C).hom :=
208	  inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 ((baseChange L M).obj ((baseChange k L).obj C)).hom)
209	
210	/-- Base change along `k → k` is the identity functor. -/
211	noncomputable def baseChange.idIso (k : Type u) [Field k] :
212	    baseChange k k ≅ 𝟭 (Over (Spec (.of k))) :=
213	  eqToIso (by
214	    change Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k k))) = Over.pullback (𝟙 _)
215	    rw [Algebra.algebraMap_self, CommRingCat.ofHom_id, Spec.map_id]) ≪≫ Over.pullbackId
216	
217	/-- Base change along a tower `k → L → M` is the composite of the two base changes. -/
218	noncomputable def baseChange.compIso (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
219	    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M] :
220	    baseChange k M ≅ baseChange k L ⋙ baseChange L M :=
221	  eqToIso (by
222	    change Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k M))) =
223	      Over.pullback (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap L M)) ≫
224	        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))
225	    rw [← Spec.map_comp, ← CommRingCat.ofHom_comp, ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_eq]) ≪≫
226	    Over.pullbackComp _ _
227	
228	namespace Jacobian
229	
230	/-- The Jacobian respects isomorphisms of curves — *derived* from the bundled functor
231	`Jacobian.functor` via `Functor.mapIso`, not a primitive. Used to compare the two sides of the
232	cocycle, whose curves agree only up to `baseChange.compIso`. -/
233	noncomputable def congr {k : Type u} [Field k] {C C' : Over (Spec (.of k))}
234	    [IsProper C.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
235	    [IsProper C'.hom] [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C'.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C'.hom]
236	    (e : C ≅ C') :
237	    (.mk (Jacobian C) : Grp (Over (Spec (.of k)))) ≅ .mk (Jacobian C') :=
238	  let j : (⟨C⟩ : Curve k) ≅ ⟨C'⟩ :=
239	    { hom := e.hom, inv := e.inv, hom_inv_id := e.hom_inv_id, inv_hom_id := e.inv_hom_id }
240	  (Jacobian.functor k).mapIso j.symm.op
241	
242	/-- **The base-change condition.** Jacobians commute with base change of fields: a canonical
243	isomorphism `Jac(C)_L ≅ Jac(C_L)`, as group schemes over `L`. -/
244	noncomputable def baseChangeIso (k L : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
245	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
246	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
247	    (baseChange k L).mapGrp.obj (.mk (Jacobian C)) ≅ .mk (Jacobian ((baseChange k L).obj C)) :=
248	  sorry
249	
250	/-! ## Functoriality: the base change isomorphisms form a coherent system. -/
251	
252	/-- Identity coherence. -/
253	theorem baseChangeIso_id (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
254	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
255	    baseChangeIso k k C =
256	      (Functor.mapGrpNatIso (baseChange.idIso k)).app _
257	        ≪≫ (Functor.mapGrpIdIso (C := Over (Spec (.of k)))).app _
258	        ≪≫ Jacobian.congr ((baseChange.idIso k).app C).symm :=
259	  sorry
260	
261	/-- Cocycle coherence for a tower `k → L → M`. -/
262	theorem baseChangeIso_comp (k L M : Type u) [Field k] [Field L] [Field M]
263	    [Algebra k L] [Algebra L M] [Algebra k M] [IsScalarTower k L M]
264	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
265	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
266	    baseChangeIso k M C
267	        ≪≫ Jacobian.congr ((baseChange.compIso k L M).app C) =
268	      (Functor.mapGrpNatIso (baseChange.compIso k L M)).app _
269	        ≪≫ (Functor.mapGrpCompIso (F := baseChange k L) (G := baseChange L M)).app _
270	        ≪≫ (baseChange L M).mapGrp.mapIso (baseChangeIso k L C)
271	        ≪≫ baseChangeIso L M ((baseChange k L).obj C) :=
272	  sorry
273	
274	/-! ## Compatibility with the Abel-Jacobi map -/
275	
276	variable {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L]
277	
278	theorem baseChange_ofCurve (C : Over (Spec (.of k))) [IsProper C.hom]
279	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
280	    (P : 𝟙_ (Over (Spec (.of k))) ⟶ C) :
281	    (baseChange k L).map (ofCurve P) ≫ (baseChangeIso k L C).hom.hom.hom =
282	      ofCurve (Functor.LaxMonoidal.ε (baseChange k L) ≫ (baseChange k L).map P) :=
283	  sorry
284	
285	end Jacobian

5	import Mathlib
6	
7	/-!
8	# Curve substrate: basic consequences of the standing hypotheses
9	
10	The Jacobian challenge (`AlgebraicJacobian.Challenge`) works with a bundle
11	`C : Over (Spec (.of k))` together with the instances `[IsProper C.hom]`,
12	`[SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom]` and `[GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]`.
13	This file records the *topological and scheme-theoretic substrate* every later wave consumes,
14	as instances keyed on the `Over`-bundle:
15	
16	* `AlgebraicGeometry.irreducibleSpace_left_of_geometricallyIrreducible`:
17	  a scheme geometrically irreducible over a field is irreducible (in particular nonempty).
18	* `AlgebraicGeometry.compactSpace_left_of_quasiCompact` and
19	  `AlgebraicGeometry.quasiSeparatedSpace_left_of_quasiSeparated`:
20	  a scheme quasi-compact (resp. quasi-separated) over `Spec k` is a quasi-compact
21	  (resp. quasi-separated) topological space; both hypotheses hold for proper morphisms.
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced`:
23	  a scheme geometrically reduced and geometrically irreducible over a field is integral.
24	  In particular Mathlib's function-field API (`Scheme.functionField`) applies to `C.left`.
25	
26	Geometric reducedness is taken as a *hypothesis* here: the implication
27	"smooth ⟹ geometrically reduced" is proved elsewhere in this project
28	(`AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.GeometricallyReduced`), never in this file.
29	
30	Statements are given for an arbitrary `X : Over (Spec (.of k))` with the minimal hypotheses,
31	so that they also apply to the Jacobian bundle itself in later waves.
32	-/
33	
34	set_option autoImplicit false
35	
36	universe u
37	
38	open CategoryTheory Limits
39	
40	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
41	
42	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
43	
44	section OverField
45	
46	variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
47	
48	/-- A scheme geometrically irreducible over a field is irreducible.
49	In particular it is nonempty (`IrreducibleSpace.toNonempty`). -/
50	instance irreducibleSpace_left_of_geometricallyIrreducible
51	    [GeometricallyIrreducible X.hom] : IrreducibleSpace X.left :=
52	  GeometricallyIrreducible.irreducibleSpace_of_subsingleton X.hom
53	
54	/-- A scheme quasi-compact over `Spec k` (e.g. proper) is a quasi-compact topological space. -/
55	instance compactSpace_left_of_quasiCompact [QuasiCompact X.hom] : CompactSpace X.left :=
56	  QuasiCompact.compactSpace_of_compactSpace X.hom
57	
58	/-- A scheme quasi-separated over `Spec k` (e.g. proper) is a quasi-separated topological
59	space. -/
60	instance quasiSeparatedSpace_left_of_quasiSeparated [QuasiSeparated X.hom] :
61	    QuasiSeparatedSpace X.left :=
62	  quasiSeparatedSpace_of_quasiSeparated X.hom
63	
64	/-- A scheme geometrically reduced and geometrically irreducible over a field is integral.
65	
66	Geometric reducedness is a hypothesis here; for the curve bundle of the challenge it is
67	supplied by "smooth ⟹ geometrically reduced", proved elsewhere in this project. -/
68	instance isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyReduced
69	    [GeometricallyIrreducible X.hom] [GeometricallyReduced X.hom] : IsIntegral X.left :=
70	  have : GeometricallyIntegral X.hom :=
71	    GeometricallyIntegral.of_geometricallyReduced_of_geometricallyIrreducible X.hom
72	  GeometricallyIntegral.isIntegral_of_subsingleton X.hom
73	
74	end OverField
75	
76	/-!

13	/-!
14	# Smooth morphisms are geometrically reduced
15	
16	A smooth morphism of schemes is geometrically reduced: every base change to the spectrum of a
17	field is reduced. Combined with geometric irreducibility, this upgrades the standing hypotheses
18	of the Jacobian challenge (`SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom` and
19	`GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom`) to `GeometricallyIntegral C.hom`, which is what all the
20	actual geometry of the project consumes.
21	
22	The commutative-algebra core is that a standard smooth algebra over a domain is reduced. By the
23	structure theorem for standard smooth algebras (Stacks 00T7,
24	`RingHom.IsStandardSmooth.exists_etale_mvPolynomial`), such an algebra `S` is étale over a
25	polynomial ring `P` over the base. Since `S` is flat over the domain `P`, it embeds into
26	`Frac(P) ⊗[P] S`, which is formally unramified and essentially of finite type over the field
27	`Frac(P)`, hence reduced by `Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field`.
28	
29	## Main results
30	
31	* `Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_isDomain`: a flat, formally unramified algebra,
32	  essentially of finite type over a domain, is reduced.
33	* `Algebra.Etale.isReduced_of_isDomain`, `RingHom.IsStandardSmooth.isReduced_of_isDomain`,
34	  `Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.isReduced_of_isDomain`: étale/standard smooth algebras over
35	  domains are reduced.
36	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.isReduced_of_field`: a scheme smooth over `Spec` of a field is
37	  reduced.
38	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.geometricallyReduced`: a smooth morphism is geometrically reduced
39	  (instance), together with the `SmoothOfRelativeDimension` variant.
40	* `AlgebraicGeometry.Smooth.geometricallyIntegral`: a smooth, geometrically irreducible
41	  morphism is geometrically integral (instance), together with the
42	  `SmoothOfRelativeDimension` variant.
43	
44	This file is written in mathlib generality and is a candidate for upstreaming.
45	-/

55	/-- A flat, formally unramified algebra, essentially of finite type over a domain, is reduced.
56	This generalizes `Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field` from fields to domains, at the
57	price of the flatness assumption (which is automatic over a field). -/
58	theorem Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_isDomain (B S : Type*) [CommRing B] [CommRing S]
59	    [IsDomain B] [Algebra B S] [Algebra.FormallyUnramified B S] [Algebra.EssFiniteType B S]
60	    [Module.Flat B S] : IsReduced S := by
61	  have : IsReduced (FractionRing B ⊗[B] S) :=
62	    Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_field (FractionRing B) (FractionRing B ⊗[B] S)
63	  refine isReduced_of_injective
64	    (Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := B) (A := FractionRing B) (B := S)) ?_
65	  have h : ⇑(Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight (R := B) (A := FractionRing B) (B := S)) =
66	      ⇑(LinearMap.rTensor S (Algebra.ofId B (FractionRing B)).toLinearMap) ∘
67	        ⇑(TensorProduct.lid B S).symm := by
68	    ext s
69	    simp
70	  rw [h]
71	  exact (Module.Flat.rTensor_preserves_injective_linearMap _
72	    (IsFractionRing.injective B (FractionRing B))).comp (TensorProduct.lid B S).symm.injective
73	
74	/-- An étale algebra over a domain is reduced. -/
75	theorem Algebra.Etale.isReduced_of_isDomain (B S : Type*) [CommRing B] [CommRing S] [IsDomain B]
76	    [Algebra B S] [Algebra.Etale B S] : IsReduced S :=
77	  Algebra.FormallyUnramified.isReduced_of_isDomain B S
78	
79	/-- The target of a standard smooth ring homomorphism out of a domain is reduced: by
80	Stacks 00T7 it is étale over a polynomial ring over the base, and étale algebras over
81	domains are reduced. -/
82	theorem RingHom.IsStandardSmooth.isReduced_of_isDomain {B S : Type*} [CommRing B] [CommRing S]
83	    [IsDomain B] {g : B →+* S} (hg : g.IsStandardSmooth) : IsReduced S := by
84	  obtain ⟨n, φ, -, hφ⟩ := hg.exists_etale_mvPolynomial
85	  algebraize [φ]
86	  exact Algebra.Etale.isReduced_of_isDomain (MvPolynomial (Fin n) B) S

89	theorem Algebra.IsStandardSmooth.isReduced_of_isDomain (B S : Type*) [CommRing B] [CommRing S]
90	    [IsDomain B] [Algebra B S] [Algebra.IsStandardSmooth B S] : IsReduced S :=

103	    IsReduced X := by
104	  have hsub : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) :=
105	    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum K))
106	  choose U hU V hV hxV e hsm using Smooth.exists_isStandardSmooth f
107	  -- Each chart is the spectrum of a standard smooth algebra over (a ring isomorphic to) `K`,
108	  -- hence reduced.
109	  have hred (x : X) : IsReduced (V x).toScheme := by
110	    have : IsAffine (V x).toScheme := hV x
111	    have hfx : f x ∈ U x := e x (hxV x)
112	    have hUx : U x = ⊤ := by
113	      refine TopologicalSpace.Opens.ext (Set.eq_univ_of_forall fun y ↦ ?_)
114	      exact Subsingleton.elim (f x) y ▸ hfx
115	    have hdom : IsDomain Γ(Spec (CommRingCat.of K), U x) := by
116	      rw [hUx]
117	      exact Function.Injective.isDomain
118	        (Scheme.ΓSpecIso (CommRingCat.of K)).commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (RingEquiv.injective _)
119	    have hΓ : _root_.IsReduced Γ(X, V x) := (hsm x).isReduced_of_isDomain
120	    have : _root_.IsReduced Γ((V x).toScheme, ⊤) :=
121	      isReduced_of_injective (V x).topIso.commRingCatIsoToRingEquiv (RingEquiv.injective _)
122	    exact isReduced_of_isAffine_isReduced _
123	  let 𝒰 : X.OpenCover := Scheme.Cover.mkOfCovers X (fun x ↦ (V x).toScheme) (fun x ↦ (V x).ι)
124	    (fun x ↦ ⟨x, ⟨x, hxV x⟩, rfl⟩) (fun x ↦ inferInstance)
125	  have : ∀ i, IsReduced (𝒰.X i) := hred
126	  exact IsReduced.of_openCover _ 𝒰

128	/-- A smooth morphism of schemes is geometrically reduced: every base change to the spectrum
129	of a field is smooth over that field, hence reduced. -/

136	/-- A morphism smooth of relative dimension `1` is smooth. This is the relative dimension of

138	`SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth`, which cannot be an instance since `n` does not occur in
139	the conclusion. -/

141	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 f] : Smooth f :=

145	since `n` cannot be inferred from the conclusion; for relative dimension `1`, instance
146	resolution goes through `Smooth.of_smoothOfRelativeDimension_one`. -/
147	theorem SmoothOfRelativeDimension.geometricallyReduced (n : ℕ) (f : X ⟶ Y)
148	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension n f] : GeometricallyReduced f :=
149	  have : Smooth f := SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth n f
150	  inferInstance

35	-/

37

39	`X.CanonicallyOver S` is the typeclass containing the data of a structure morphism `X ↘ S : X ⟶ S`,
40	and that `S` is (uniquely) inferable from the structure of `X`.
41	-/
42	abbrev CanonicallyOver (X S : Scheme.{u}) := CanonicallyOverClass X S
43

45	`f.IsOver S` is the typeclass asserting `f` commutes with the structure morphisms. -/
46	abbrev Hom.IsOver (f : X.Hom Y) (S : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over S] [Y.Over S] := HomIsOver f S
